about.title: About
about.text: I've been podcasting since 2020. Today I host Bom dia Tech, with the top tech news every Tuesday and Thursday, and I'm a recurring special guest on Área de Transferência. I also created A Era do Pixel, about movies, TV series and comics.

about.title: about
about.text: Senior iOS & Mobile Engineer from Rio de Janeiro with over 10 years of experience. I specialize in Swift, SwiftUI, modular architectures, Bluetooth/BLE integration and Flutter, with time in fintech, IoT and large-scale e-commerce. I use Claude Code and OpenAI Codex every day, pairing AI-assisted development with critical review, architectural decisions and ownership of what ships.
